items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: Mr. Bill, I'm going to tell you something. Friday night coming, it's going to have a van right around the corner if you can come out with it.

ctx.x: They don't. But still yet, lots of people goes for that. Now, Mr. Bill, I'm going to tell you something. Friday night coming, it's going to have a van right around the corner if you can come out with it.
I'm going to be, I have to leave, I'm going to leave tomorrow night, I think. And go up to see my mother that, don't you?
